about_the_game:
In Shadow of the Union, crafting is the key to successfully completing government contracts. Using collected materials and secret vials, you can create items and upgrades for your base and equipment. Every item you craft helps increase the efficiency of mission completion and ensures the smooth operation of your base.

The base is a key part of survival and contract completion. It’s your refuge and starting point for missions. Build and upgrade your base in preparation for monster waves by placing defensive structures and automating protection with electrical systems and turrets. Also, prepare your vehicle for missions by upgrading it with necessary resources. Your base must withstand any threats and ensure security for the successful completion of contracts.

Each sortie is part of a secret mission. Explore forgotten locations from the USSR era — from destroyed military sites to the depths of classified laboratories and bunkers. Radiation, traps, and aggressive mutants are just obstacles on your path to the goal. Use transport for equipment delivery and emergency evacuation, collect evidence, resources, and data. Attention and caution are key to success.

In cooperative mode, up to 4 players face traps, enemies, and secrets of the past. Each player has an important role — reconnaissance, support, or combat. Victory requires clear division of duties, tactics, and teamwork. Use the built-in voice chat to coordinate actions in real time — as communication at critical moments can save your team. Only coordinated effort and trust will help you survive in this dangerous world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel Core i5-8250U or better
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i7-4790K or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Shadow of the Union is a cooperative game for 1-4 players, where you are sent by the government to the most dangerous zones to complete contracts, explore anomalous places, and fend off monster attacks. Build your base and prepare for an assault on your shelter.

English*, German*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support
